records.text: Victor Marx Group LLC has a Class 1 Federal Firearms License, making Victor Marx a licensed firearm dealer.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: Colorado Springs where he lives you will find he has an FFL class one license what that means is he is a fire a licensed firearm dealer he is a licensed firearm dealer now I don't know about your preachers I've had a few over my years I don't believe any of them have been licensed firearms dealers

verification.notes: Current ATF-sourced license listings identify Victor Marx Group LLC as holding an active Type 01 FFL, which authorizes dealing in firearms other than destructive devices. However, the license is held by the LLC; the reviewed records do not establish that Victor Marx personally holds the license or is a listed responsible person. The company-license portion is true, while the personal-license inference is not established.

records.text: Victor Marx denies ever asking Corby Hall for 50,000 weapons and says he has a Federal Firearms License used only to buy equipment for his own training.
records.speaker: Victor Marx

appearances.snippet: I can tell you I never, ... never did ... guns I ask, never did I ask Corey (Corey Kennedy), Corby (Corby Hall) for 50,000 weapons. Why? I have an FFL. ... I only buy stuff for ourself, for our training. That's ridiculous. That's absurd.

verification.notes: Current ATF-derived listings confirm that Victor Marx Group holds an active Type 01 Federal Firearms License. Hall has publicly made the 50,000-rifle allegation and Marx denies it; no conclusive transaction record resolves that dispute, and the claim that the license is used only for internal training is not independently documented.
